instruction: The last Venmo payment request I sent to Brandon was an accident and they approved it. Send them the money back.
notes: Two apps (phone, venmo) declared as constants. supervisor.show_profile yields the login usernames (phone number for phone, email for venmo), modeled via static (login-username app u) facts gated by (profile-known). Brandon's email is a runtime entity: (email-of brandon brandon-email) is a static association, (known-email ...) becomes true only after phone.search_contacts with query 'Brandon'. The latest approved sent payment request to Brandon and its amount are modeled as runtime objects discovered by venmo.show_sent_payment_requests (status='approved', filtered by receiver email); its effect (refund-amount-known brandon amt) gates venmo.create_transaction, which must send exactly that amount to Brandon's email (description is optional but used, as in the reference). supervisor.complete_task takes the person/amount task records (not API args) so its precondition equals the goal's task-specific condition; no answer is required. Goal: transaction sent to Brandon for the request amount plus (task-completed).

plan: (venmo-show-sent-payment-requests phone-token status-approved brandon brandon-email last-approved-request-to-brandon amount-of-last-request-to-brandon)
